name: slab
description: Lossless dielectric slab at normal incidence in a periodic 2D cell (TMz: Ez, Hx, Hy). Solvers without a 2D mode use a 3D grid with one periodic cell along z.

slab.note: Ez nodes at x=-4+k*0.025 um; the slab covers the eight Ez nodes x=-0.075..0.100 um (indices 157..164), i.e. exactly 0.2 um of staircased material.

source.note: Additive (soft) Ez sheet over the whole periodic y span at one x node, applied after the E update of every step with the sample at t=(n+1)*dt.

spectrum.note: 31 samples equally spaced in frequency between c/1.8um and c/1.3um.
